cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI launches DeployCo, a new enterprise deployment company built to help organizations bring frontier AI into production and turn it into measurable business impact.

cluster_stories.summary: $30bn went to OpenAI; the rest is spread across CoreWeave, IREN, Corning, Nebius, and roughly two dozen private rounds. The pattern is closer to vertical integration than to venture investing, and is starting to draw the inevitable circular-deal questions. NVIDIA has committed more than $40 billion to AI equity investments in the first four months […] This story continues at The Next Web

cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI has set up a new venture called OpenAI Deployment Company, with more than $4bn in initial funding from a syndicate of 19 firms led by TPG and including Advent International, Bain Capital and Brookfield as co-lead founding partners, the company said on Monday. The new entity, which will be majority-owned and controlled by OpenAI, […] This story continues at The Next Web

cluster_stories.title: Microsoft boss Satya Nadella to testify on his role in OpenAI's founding
cluster_stories.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella is expected to take the stand Monday in Elon Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI, to explain emails that revealed how his company funded the ChatGPT creator's shift from philanthropic organisation to for-profit AI giant. He will rely on recently disclosed Microsoft emails from January 2018 to demonstrate that the tech giant only opened its checkbook once a profit appeared possible.
cluster_stories.headline: MICROSOFT CEO NADELLA to Testify in Musk vs OpenAI

Court documents from the Musk v. Altman trial revealed this week that the stake carries a target redemption value of two billion dollars. A university endowment made […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: Michigan's $20M OpenAI Bet Now Worth $2 BILLION

cluster_stories.title: Microsoft Targeted $92 Billion Return on Early OpenAI Investment
cluster_stories.summary: Microsoft Corp. targeted a $92 billion return from its large early investments in OpenAI, a landmark arrangement that helped usher in the current AI era.
cluster_stories.headline: MICROSOFT TARGETED $92B RETURN ON OPENAI INVESTMENT

cluster_stories.title: Family of Florida mass shooting victim sues OpenAI in US court
cluster_stories.summary: A family has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI. They claim ChatGPT helped a shooter plan a 2025 mass shooting at Florida State University. The shooter used the chatbot for months. The lawsuit states the chatbot did not flag dangerous conversations. OpenAI denies responsibility, stating ChatGPT provided public information. The company is cooperating with law enforcement.
cluster_stories.headline: FAMILY SUES OPENAI: ChatGPT Helped Plan Mass Shooting

polls.description: South Korea is pioneering government policies to redistribute AI profits to citizens as tech companies boom.
polls.question: Should South Korea redistribute AI profits to all citizens?

cluster_stories.title: South Korea Exploring Using Hyundai Robots as Army Numbers Fall
cluster_stories.summary: South Korea’s military is exploring a strategic partnership with Hyundai Motor Co. to potentially deploy robotics to the front lines as Seoul accelerates investment in AI-powered, unmanned systems to tackle a deepening troop shortage.
cluster_stories.headline: SOUTH KOREA MILITARY EXPLORES HYUNDAI COMBAT ROBOTS as Troops Decline

cluster_stories.title: AI Dividend Proposal Roils Korean Market | Bloomberg Tech 5/12/2026
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Caroline Hyde and Ed Ludlow discuss comments by a South Korean policymaker that the country should pay citizens a “dividend” using taxes on AI profits. Plus, the largest US derivatives exchange, CME, is planning to create a futures market for computing power, one of the key drivers of the AI boom. And, the CEO of SAP talks about the company’s push into AI agents across business operations. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: KOREA PROPOSES AI DIVIDEND FOR CITIZENS

cluster_stories.title: South Korea official floats AI profit social tax as tech giants boom
cluster_stories.summary: A top South Korean official has proposed a tax on AI profits to be redistributed among society as a semiconductor boom drives massive earnings for tech giants Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. Kim proposed what he tentatively called a "national dividend" for socially redistributing excess corporate profits from AI technology.
cluster_stories.headline: SOUTH KOREA FLOATS AI PROFIT TAX... Samsung Boom Triggers Redistribution

cluster_stories.title: South Korea Floats ‘Citizen Dividend’ Using AI Profits
cluster_stories.summary: South Korea should pay all citizens a share of AI profits, a top policymaker has urged, as a labor dispute threatens to disrupt production at Samsung Electronics Co.’s chip division.
cluster_stories.headline: SOUTH KOREA PROPOSES AI PROFIT SHARING... CITIZEN DIVIDEND
